stateDiagram-v2
 [*] --> Starting
 Starting --> Running: contained spawn
 Starting --> Failed: launch failure
 Running --> Draining: root exit with descendants or open streams
 Running --> Stopping: cancel or explicit resource limit
 Draining --> Stopping: cancel or drain failure
 Running --> Completed: tree empty and streams drained
 Draining --> Completed: tree empty and streams drained
 Stopping --> Cancelled: verified tree cleanup
 Stopping --> Failed: cleanup uncertainty
 Completed --> [*]
 Cancelled --> [*]
 Failed --> [*]

data.title: Process session supervision and bounded I/O
